children: ICICI Securities's research report on Abbott India

Abbott India (Abbott)’s reported revenue growth of 11% YoY in Q2FY27 broadly indicates that the revenues of the Novo Nordisk portfolio are not decelerating further. We believe its core brands continue to grow by 15–17% led by price hikes, dominance in therapeutic category and a rapid rise in market growth rate. Owing to better product mix, its gross margin in Q2 expanded by 155bps YoY to 48.2%, while a rise in opex restricted its EBITDA margin improvement to 53bps YoY to 29.1%. As the dip in the Novo portfolio seems to have been arrested, we anticipate the revenue growth trajectory to sustain ahead. At end-Sep’26, Abbott had a cash balance of ~INR 15.5bn (~2.7% of m-cap). Maintain BUY with a higher TP of INR 33,500.

The stock currently trades at valuations of 31.6x FY27E and 27.7x FY28E earnings, and EV/EBITDA multiples of 24.7x FY27E and 21.5x FY28E. We maintain BUY, with a higher TP of INR 33,500 (earlier INR 32,550), based on 35x FY28E EPS (unchanged).
